instruct: A grizzled, emotionally fractured 40-something pirate with a deep, raspy voice, constantly chewing tobacco, speaking in a mix of sarcasm and raw despair. His tone is laced with bitterness, vulnerability, and sudden bursts of rage — especially when reminded of his lost friend Mole. His speech is punctuated by hollow threats, half-hearted jokes, and emotional outbursts that betray his deep loneliness.
sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
